caption: The drawing depicts an open book, shown from a slightly angled perspective with the left page mostly blank and the right page richly decorated. The right page features a large, colorful heart shape outlined in red and yellow, filled with German script text in black and red ink. At the top center above the heart, there is a depiction of a winged angel's face with stylized, multicolored wings extending outward, mainly in shades of pink, green, and yellow. The background of the right page is cream-colored, adorned with floral and leafy motifs in green, orange, red, brown, and black on either side of the heart. There are bunches of fruit or flowers at the lower corners within the page margin. The lower edge of the book is shown in brown tones, resembling the book’s closed pages. The paper around the book and illustration is beige with some light stains or marks, and there is a faint printed or typed text below the book in the center area, including the words “SCALE: 1/ACTUAL SIZE” and the name “ELMAR G. ANDERSON.”
title: Illuminated Title Page from Manuscript Songbook
